Token row locked by (app_id, sha256); unknown / cross-app / expired / revoked answer 10404 without revocation; device mismatch revokes the sid (refresh_reuse) with the afterRevoked hook; rotation fills rotated_at once, inserts the parent_hash successor with a 30-day expiry from the injected Clock, re-decides the scope from this request, keeps the sid, and stores the encrypted pair in Redis refresh_grace (30 s) before commit; grace returns the identical pair only within 30 s with an unrotated successor and an existing entry (read failure 50001, missing entry = reuse → revoke); concurrent double rotation handled by the row lock and the parent_hash unique constraint. Contract refreshToken leaves planned; route-schemas regenerated. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
